svg.font-family: Noto Sans, Open Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Hollowmere arena map preview (720 x 1280 phone, arena 720 x 760)
svg.desc: Preview drawn from game/data/arena_map.json. Blue half at the bottom, player team shown as teal circles, rival as coral hexagons (C4 ruling: you = teal circle, them = coral hexagon; colours are the ART-BIBLE tokens ACCENT and CORAL). The four gate guard towers are drawn dimmer: scenery, never counted on the scoreboard (6 counted towers per side). Header, feed and buttons are placeholders for layout only.
